letter: The month brought back the same short nights you had been circling before the deadline, when the heart rate variability dropped and the evenings felt too narrow to hold everything. Then came the long walk that doubled the week and felt like clearing, followed by the first deliberate rest day taken this month. The unrecorded movement on the quieter days did not mean stillness, any more than the missing sleep data meant the nights simply did not happen. Through the journal entries and the longer stretches, the steady rhythm returned on its own terms.
